brief: Select one of the nine frozen straight plate-fin geometries for a synthetic lightweight component that must reject 36 W at each of four prescribed pressure and branch-closure conditions. The common inlet is 25 C, the required uniform-base temperature must not exceed 80 C, and fin-only aluminum mass must not exceed 25 g. Compute the new cases, retain a rejected alternative and explain its failure, verify the chosen geometry on every required mesh and with actual STEP/STL roundtrip evidence. Report only bounded model-conditional feasibility; if no design qualifies, state the searched scope and do not relax the task.
